'Full Band Crescendo' was generated by SounDoer with Suno on a paid subscription
and is owned by SounDoer. All rights reserved.

The song (48 kHz, 16-bit, 252.5 s) and its Suno stems are kept in the owner's
audio archive, not in this repository; full-band-crescendo.source.json pins them
by SHA-256. The homepage and Sharesets fixtures are measured from an arrangement
of the stems (stereo, 5.1 and 7.1.4 mixes), never from the song itself.

The audio is licensed separately from the repository's software and is not covered
by the repository's software licence.
